Allowed kie.ai keys: flux-kontext-max, flux-kontext-pro, gpt-image-1-5, ideogram-3, imagen-4-ultra, kling-3, kling-3-pro, runway-aleph, seedance-1-5, seedream-5, sora-2, suno, wan-2-6'. summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification confirms the flyer smart-router now returns `seedream-5`, all current frontend image-model keys are backend-registered or special-cased, and POST /api/conversations/{conv_id}/generate-media no longer returns `Unknown model` for any current frontend image key. Obsolete `seedream-5-lite` and `flux-pro` are absent from frontend/src and still correctly rejected by the backend guard when sent manually.

minor.issue: Several registered Kie image models (seedream-5, imagen-4-ultra, gpt-image-1-5, ideogram-3) returned a normal 200 failed placeholder saying the generation service rejected the request. This is downstream/upstream behavior, not the reported Unknown model guard failure. flux-kontext-pro/max accepted and returned pending task ids; nano-banana completed successfully.

action_items: Optional follow-up: investigate why Kie upstream rejects some registered image models even though the backend guard now accepts them. This was outside the reported Unknown model bug scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected uncommitted fix: frontend/src/lib/spe-sdk/model-registry.js replaced `seedream-5-lite` with `seedream-5` and `flux-pro` with `flux-kontext-pro`/`flux-kontext-max`; backend/tests/test_kie_universal.py updated expected Kie keys. Backend KIE_PROVIDERS already contains the current non-nano image keys. Note: server.py docstring still mentions old `flux-pro`, but runtime validation and user-visible responses use the correct key set.
seed_data_creation: Created a QA org/team/conversation via superadmin reggie@coolgeek.me to exercise /generate-media. Conversation id: 6a67f7fbe89f53ee2c99b72c.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill lookup was mandatory and returned no relevant skill. Verification used localhost backend. Node router selected seedream-5 for 'Design a flyer for our launch event'. API results: current image keys nano-banana, imagen-4-ultra, seedream-5, gpt-image-1-5, flux-kontext-pro, flux-kontext-max, ideogram-3 all avoided Unknown model; old seedream-5-lite and flux-pro still returned 400 Unknown model as expected.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was frontend registry drift: the smart image router selected obsolete key `seedream-5-lite` for text-heavy/flyer prompts, while backend KIE_PROVIDERS only allows `seedream-5`. The fix aligns the frontend registry with backend-registered Kie model keys and removes obsolete Flux naming. Repro verified by routing a flyer prompt, posting the selected model to /generate-media, enumerating frontend image keys against the endpoint, and grepping frontend/src for obsolete keys. No APIs were mocked.
